extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvalue
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Scalar λ such that Ax = λx for a nonzero vector x.

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Nonzero vector x satisfying Ax = λx.

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvalue equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation Ax = λx.

extracted_concepts.name: Characteristic equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: det(A - λI) = 0, whose roots are eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Determinant
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Scalar det used to form the characteristic equation.

extracted_concepts.name: Identity matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix I used in A - λI.

extracted_concepts.name: Null space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set of vectors v with (A - λI)v = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Diagonalization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Writing A = SΛS⁻¹ using eigenvectors and eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Diagonalizable matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix A that can be expressed as SΛS⁻¹.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix S
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix whose columns are eigenvectors in diagonalization.

extracted_concepts.name: Diagonal matrix Λ
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Diagonal matrix with eigenvalues on the diagonal.

extracted_concepts.name: Linearly independent eigenvectors
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: n eigenvectors needed for diagonalizability.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix powers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Computing Aⁿ = SΛⁿS⁻¹.

extracted_concepts.name: Differential equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Systems dx/dt = Ax solved via eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Markov chains
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Application involving eigenvalues and steady states.

extracted_concepts.name: PageRank
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Application based on Markov chains and eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Principal Component Analysis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Application using eigenvalues and eigenvectors of covariance matrices.

extracted_concepts.name: Symmetric matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix with A = Aᵀ.

extracted_concepts.name: Real symmetric matrices
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Symmetric matrices over the reals with real eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Real eigenvalues
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Eigenvalues of real symmetric matrices are real.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthogonal eigenvectors
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Eigenvectors of real symmetric matrices are orthogonal.

extracted_concepts.name: Spectral Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A = QΛQᵀ for real symmetric A.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthogonal matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix Q with orthogonal columns and Q⁻¹ = Qᵀ.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Transformation whose essential behavior is captured by eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Scaling behavior
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: How a transformation scales along special eigen-directions.
